info.title: typewriter
info.description: Command-line Typewriter generator for TypeScript output from C# projects and .tst templates.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Generate TypeScript from C# projects using Typewriter templates.

options.name: --workspace
options.description: Path to a solution, project, or workspace folder.

options.name: --project
options.description: Path to the C# project to read.

options.name: --template
options.description: Path to a Typewriter template or template directory.

options.name: --template-search-path
options.description: Directory used to discover templates without changing the workspace or project.

options.name: --framework
options.description: Target framework to use when loading project metadata.

options.name: --output
options.description: Output format. [default: text]

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Run generation without writing files.

options.name: --fail-on-warning
options.description: Return a non-zero exit code when warnings are emitted.

options.name: --all-projects
options.description: Generate for every project in a multi-project workspace.

options.name: --diff
options.description: Include unified diffs for changed files in the output.

options.name: --changed
options.description: Path of an input file changed since the previous generation. May be repeated. When every changed input is a C# source file, only the affected outputs are re-rendered.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information
